title: Chase → IHG: 70% bonus (1:1.7)
description: 1,000 Ultimate Rewards become 1,700 IHG points through Aug 31. Second tier of the summer promo (the 100% tier ended Jul 30). Transfers take ~5 hours. Re-confirmed live 8/10 by all four trackers.
verdict: IHG points run ~0.5¢ each, so 1:1.7 is ~0.85¢ of hotel value per UR — only worth it with a specific IHG stay priced out. Never transfer speculatively.
source_label: Frequent Miler + AwardWallet + Award Travel Finder + TPG (4/4 trackers)

title: Amex → British Airways Avios: 30% bonus (1:1.3)

verdict: The longest-runway bonus live right now. Avios sweet spots (short-haul partner flights, AA domestic awards via BA) make 1:1.3 legitimately useful — but Avios devalue often, so transfer against a bookable award, not on spec.
source_label: Frequent Miler + AwardWallet + Award Travel Finder + TPG (4/4 trackers)

title: Amex → Iberia Avios: 30% bonus (1:1.3)

verdict: Iberia's off-peak Madrid awards from the East Coast are the classic use. Same Avios pool as BA — pick whichever program prices your award cheapest.
source_label: Frequent Miler + AwardWallet + Award Travel Finder + TPG (4/4 trackers)

title: Amex → Aer Lingus Avios: 30% bonus (1:1.3)

source_label: Frequent Miler + AwardWallet + Award Travel Finder + TPG (4/4 trackers)

title: Citi → Turkish Miles&Smiles: 40% bonus (1:1.4)

verdict: Turkish's Star Alliance award chart has real gems (domestic US on United from 10k round-trip, business to Europe from 45k) — at 1:1.4 those get very cheap. But Miles&Smiles booking friction is real; confirm the award books online before sending points.
source_label: Frequent Miler + Award Travel Finder + TPG (8/31) vs AwardWallet (8/30)

title: ANNOUNCED: Chase → Hyatt drops from 1:1 to 4:3 for CSP/Ink on Oct 1
description: Announced by Chase Jun 2026: the Hyatt transfer ratio falls from 1:1 to 4:3 for Sapphire Preferred, Ink Business Preferred, Ink Plus, and Corporate Flex. Accounts opened on/after Jun 15, 2026 are already at 4:3; everyone else keeps 1:1 only through Sep 30, 2026. Sapphire Reserve (and Reserve for Business) keep 1:1 indefinitely. 1,000-pt increments. Detected from Chase-confirmed reporting — not a prediction.
verdict: Act-before math: every 1,000 UR transferred after Sep 30 buys 750 Hyatt points instead of 1,000 — a 25% haircut. If your UR are Hyatt-bound and CSP/Ink is your only path, transfer what you can realistically use before Oct 1.

title: ANNOUNCED: Wyndham's new award chart lands Sep 15 — top tier +50%
description: Announced Jun 25, 2026, effective Sep 15, 2026: Wyndham moves from 3 award tiers (7,500/15,000/30,000) to 4 (5,000/15,000/30,000/45,000). A new 5,000 bottom tier is a genuine improvement, but a new 45,000 top tier means the most desirable properties jump up to +50%, and properties re-tier in both directions with counts undisclosed. Bookings made before Sep 15 are honored at old pricing (auto-refund if a property's tier drops). Earner Premier cardholders get a 25% award discount (45,000 → 33,750). Confirmed by Frequent Miler, One Mile at a Time, and Wyndham's own tier-update page — detected, not predicted.
verdict: A 100k Wyndham balance that covered three top-tier nights (30k each) may cover only two after Sep 15. If you're eyeing a marquee Wyndham/Vacasa redemption, book it before Sep 15 to lock old pricing — bookings are honored.
end_label: Last day at old chart — Mon Sep 14
source_label: Wyndham (official tier-update page) + Frequent Miler + One Mile at a Time
